_comment: Source-stratified eval set (28 questions) grounded in REAL, verified Apache Flink artifacts. Every gold fact below was confirmed against issues.apache.org (Jira), github.com/apache/flink (PRs/authors), cwiki.apache.org (FLIPs), or nightlies.apache.org (config/docs) — no fabricated IDs. 'source' groups questions the way they were requested: general (Flink docs/concepts), jira (issue-tracker content), pr-commit (GitHub PR/commit content), mailing-list (dev@ discussion content). 'mustContain' = case-insensitive substrings correct retrieval must surface; the scorer only reads 'mustContain'. 'difficulty'/'expectedStrength' are analysis metadata. NOTE: PR-author handles (AHeise, wsry, 1996fanrui, SteNicholas) are real Flink committer GitHub usernames and double as discriminating gold facts. Adjust gold facts to YOUR corpus's stored format if it differs (e.g. 'PR-12493' vs '12493').
